system.notes:
Acts twice a round. Each action: Dagger (d8) and one spell of up to 3 Gift Dice. 6 Gift Dice: Frostfall (Fireball; GRACE for half), Mine! (RESOLVE), Thorns (Tangle; RESOLVE), Splinters (Magic Dart; cannot be dodged), Bubble (Reaction), Disguise (WITS). One healing potion (2d4+4), drunk at 10 HP or less.

Vow Pillars: up to four stand round the throne, one per founder whose Echo was not freed. While any stands she cannot drop below 1 HP and regains 3 HP per pillar at the start of each round.

The throne: on the dais, all damage to her is halved and she casts Bubble at 1 die as a free Reaction each round. Smooch with a total of at least half her current HP costs her a round and the throne's protection.

Founder of the Perils & Princesses Society; first Luminary; designer of the Silver Rose Pin; author of the oath. Her heart was frozen by the Frostbind curse her four friends could not break. She can be fought or saved. At 0 HP she becomes Morwenna, Frost-Crowned.

Much harder than the core book's Evil Queen (HP 10) by GM ruling.
